name: Women Make

sources.title: Homepage — community feed with Article/Question/Launch/Event/Discussion post types

conditions: Community for women entrepreneurs and makers — a launch post is only a fit if the founder is a woman; posting requires an account
requirements: Community is explicitly 'a safe space for women entrepreneurs and makers'
Account required — login is via Telegram bot (@WomenMakeBot), no email/password flow
Launch posts are one of six post types (Article, Question, Launch, Event, Discussion, AMAs & Interviews)
preparation: Launch post copy consistent with community tone (narrative journey posts perform better than pure promos)
workflow: Send /login to @WomenMakeBot on Telegram to authenticate
Create a post with type 'Launch' linking the product
Engage in comments — community norms favor participation
watchFor: Audience-restricted community — posting as a non-member demographic would violate the space's intent
Telegram-bot login is the only auth — no web signup form
Founding-membership and sponsorship links exist in the footer (paid channels for visibility)
countsAsLive: The launch post appears in the community feed under the Launch category
unknowns: Whether launches from non-member accounts are moderated out
